text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Start of Your Main Phase] You may place up to 1 [Hybrid] trait card with different names from your trash under this Tamer. For each of your other Tamers, add 2 to the maximum number this effect may place.
(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Takuya Kanbara]/[Koji Minamoto].

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait may attack a player.

qa.answer:
You may choose 1 card with a combination of having the [Hybrid] trait and a different name from your trash and place it under this Tamer.
For each of your other Tamers, you add 2 to the maximum number of cards this effect may place under this Tamer.
For example, if you have 1 Tamer other than this Tamer, you can choose up to 3 cards with the [Hybrid] trait and different names from your trash and place them under this Tamer.
qa.question: What does this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect do, exactly?

qa.answer:
No, it can't attack. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack.
In such cases, even if you activate this card's [End of Your Turn] inherited effect when you already have an attacking digimon, a new attack can't be performed using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards.
qa.question:
My Digimon is attacking using an effect at the end of my turn.
Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] inherited effect to attack a player using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards?
